search_text: published ZDI-14-202 ZDI-CAN-2295 AlienVault OSSIM av-centerd Util.pm update_system_info_debian_package Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-06-11 CVE-2014-3804 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-3804 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['AlienVault'] ['OSSIM'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of AlienVault OSSIM. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the av-centerd SOAP service. The issue lies in the handling of the update_system_info_debian_package requests due to a failure to safely sanitize user data before executing a command. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to execute code with root privileges. AlienVault has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
